description: Lighthouse is a fast, secure Ethereum consensus (beacon chain) client written in Rust. It must be paired with an execution client — such as the Geth template in this list — via the Engine API to run a full Ethereum node.
name: lighthouse
note: Requires a shared JWT secret with the execution client at /root/.lighthouse/jwt.hex, and its --execution-endpoint should point at your execution client's authenticated Engine API port (default 8551).
title: Lighthouse
